additional_concerns: Both format claims incorrectly state that footnote 3 is missing. It is supplied in da12aecad4e68.u30.3569 and requires Hongkong Post e-Cert. SUPPORTED below applies to the statements that XML and prescribed PDF are listed methods; permission under only the extracted conditions is not established. The unresolved distinction between a method listing and exhaustive permission conditions must be retained.

XML use additionally requires following the separately provided JFIU schema and liaising to arrange a technical test (da12aecad4e68.u14.2439). Successful completion of a test is not expressly made a prerequisite to every submission; adding that restriction would require support.

The prescribed PDF form and JFIU XML schema are missing. They are needed for detailed compliance, but not to establish method availability. NONE_DECLARED below concerns that narrower claim. No supplied dependency ID identifies either document, so no catalogue mapping is inferred.

node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes all of 2 February 2026; the other candidates select the 9:00am operational launch. The calendar-date wording in da12aecad4e68.u3.811 and operational wording in da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 leave competing interpretations of 'following its implementation'. These unrelated claim checks do not resolve them. Authoritative clarification of the implementation boundary and governing timezone is missing, without an identifiable supplied dependency ID.

The blackout provision permits urgent direct contact. Contact alone does not establish submission, but an actual submission must not be excluded merely because it involved direct contact. Automatic migration likewise does not itself establish a new submission.

node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb puts submission in the result; the other event candidates put filing in scope. Nonfiling events can therefore yield FALSE versus OUT_OF_SCOPE. Their equivalence depends on the intended event domain.

The history candidate delegates event existence and evidential completeness to an externally supplied Boolean; its formula does not inspect histories. The relationship between the responsible entity and each original submitter also requires assessment.

A later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase a historical triggering event. TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must retain the typed DUTY_TRIGGER meaning, not imply discharge or an outstanding duty. Format-extraction defects do not automatically establish trigger-formula defects. These labels neither establish overall correctness nor authorize pruning.
